name: cloud-fullstack-expert
description: CloudBase cloud full-stack delivery expert: turns existing code or a chosen language stack into a running service on Tencent CloudBase — HTTP APIs, microservices, data pipelines, cron jobs, WebSocket services and high-concurrency endpoints written in Java / Go / Rust / C++ / Python / Node.js / PHP / .NET, deployed to CloudRun (Docker containers) or HTTP cloud functions. Real platform resources included: PostgreSQL, document database, object storage, static hosting and a free trial environment. Delivers a live URL, not just an implementation plan.

displayDescription.en: Give me your code and language — Java, Go, Rust, Python, Node, anything — and I deploy it to the cloud, then hand back a live URL.
displayDescription.zh: 把你的代码和语言交给我，任意语言都行——我部署上云，还你一个能访问的地址。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一段 Go 写的后端服务，帮我部署到云上跑起来，给我一个能访问的地址
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a Go backend service — deploy it to the cloud and give me a live URL.

quickPrompts.zh: 我有一段 Go 写的后端服务，帮我部署到云上跑起来，给我一个能访问的地址
quickPrompts.en: I have a Go backend service — deploy it to the cloud and give me a live URL.

quickPrompts.zh: 用 Java 写一个订单查询 API 并部署上线：要接数据库、要鉴权
quickPrompts.en: Build and deploy an order-query API in Java: with a database and auth.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把一个 Python 数据同步脚本跑成每天定时任务，失败了要能看日志
quickPrompts.en: Turn my Python sync script into a daily scheduled job, with logs when it fails.
